title: Answer: experience is basic, at the level of the cosmos

statements.text: Experience is basic, and its most fundamental form is the consciousness of the cosmos. Ordinary experience is derived from it. On Shani and Keppler’s view consciousness and selfhood are both fundamental features of reality, and what calls for explanation is the existence of perspectival selves with structured experience.

sources.quote: consciousness and selfhood are posited as fundamental features of reality
the cosmic consciousness is the most fundamental form of phenomenality
